experiment_label: Author-declared replacement: joint pressure/saturation operator training

value.task: joint supervised pressure and water-saturation prediction for oil-water reservoir simulations
value.coordinates: x,y,t retained for preprocessing/gradient loss; removed from direct model input
value.loss: relative pressure L2 + masked saturation relative L2 + pressure-gradient discrepancy + saturation-gradient discrepancy
value.gradient_operator: torch.gradient on labeled and predicted spatial fields
value.saturation_mask: magnitude of true saturation spatial gradient > 0.01

value.spectral_transform: 3D rfftn/irfftn with four learned complex frequency quadrants
value.activation: ReLU between operator blocks and in final projection; U-Net uses LeakyReLU
value.documented_tensor_shape: batch x 40 x 40 x 40 x channels

value.serialization: two consecutive np.load reads from one file: inputs then outputs
value.window_selection: train starts randint(0,200); validation starts randint(0,total_time-40); first 10 percent set to zero
value.initial_conditions: first frame of each selected output window inserted as input channels 4,5
value.pressure_scaling: divide pressure fields/control/initial pressure by training output pmax
value.coordinate_scaling: spatial min/max, time by training max_time
value.augmentation: concatenate original plus flips in x, y and both axes
value.external_test: README separate 200-sample test file; not used in training-script validation

value.validation: same five loss components as training, divided by sample count
value.periodic_save: current model state every 50 zero-based epochs, including epoch 0
value.final_state: best_model_state was last copied at zero-based epoch 750, not after epoch 799
value.final_path: os.path.join(os.getcwd(),leading-slash filename), which targets filesystem root on POSIX

notes: Mapping is to the replacement source and its explicit provenance statement; no claim of source equivalence to an unavailable historical commit.
